historicalIncident.finding: The DMG and ZIP shared an app.asar containing 58 unintended files under a local worktree path, including one settings-category filename whose contents were deliberately not read. The macOS outer payload also lacked the separately expected Electron and Chromium notices.

localUnsignedCandidate.purpose: Content, architecture, container integrity and exact asset-contract evidence only. These local artifacts are deliberately unsigned and are not publishable.

checks.exactAssetContract: PASS: exactly two DMGs, two ZIPs and two ZIP blockmaps; no DMG blockmap or update metadata.
checks.architectures: PASS: one arm64 app and one x86_64 app.
checks.dmgIntegrity: PASS: hdiutil verify succeeded for arm64 and x64.
checks.containerInspection: PASS: package policy ran against both unpacked apps, both extracted ZIP apps and both mounted-DMG apps.
checks.asarPolicy: PASS: 10,109 paths in each app.asar; runtime allowlist and sensitive/private path deny rules passed.
checks.outerNotices: PASS: project LICENSE/NOTICE/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and Electron/Chromium notices matched their pinned local sources in every inspected app.

remoteReleaseGate.requiredVerifierCoverage: Every unpacked, extracted-ZIP and mounted-DMG app must pass Developer ID, expected Team ID, hardened runtime, Gatekeeper, notarization/stapler, version/channel and package-policy checks.
remoteReleaseGate.tagBinding: The release tag commit must equal the current origin/master tip at both pre-build and pre-publish checks; master is frozen between tag creation and release publication.
remoteReleaseGate.sideEffectBoundary: The smoke workflow must not create a tag, GitHub Release, published update metadata or Pages deployment.
